title: Where are you from?
summary: Say where you are from and give your nationality, for a man and for a woman.
intro: Arabic has no word for 'am / is / are' in the present: أَنَا مِصْرِيّ is simply 'I Egyptian'. Nationalities end in ـِيّ for a man and ـِيَّة for a woman. New letters: د ذ ر ز. None of them joins the letter after it.
objectives: Give a nationality for a man and for a woman
Read and write dāl, dhāl, rāʾ and zāy

realLife.title: Coffee break
realLife.story: In the break, Layla, Sami and Daniel drink tea in the school courtyard. The class has students from many countries, and the first question everyone asks is مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟

mistakes.why: A man takes the masculine form -ī; -iyya is for a woman.

sentences.en: Where are you from? (to a woman)

dialogue.title: Where is everyone from?
dialogue.culture: Cairo (الْقَاهِرَة) is the largest city in the Arab world. Egyptians often call their country and its capital by the same name, مَصْر, in everyday speech.

lines.ar: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ يَا دَانْيَال؟ مِنْ أَمْرِيكَا؟
lines.en: Where are you from, Daniel? Are you from America?

lines.ar: نَعَم، أَنَا أَمْرِيكِيّ مِنْ شِيكَاغُو. وَأَنْتِ؟
lines.en: Yes, I am American, from Chicago. And you?

lines.ar: أَنَا لُبْنَانِيَّة مِنْ بَيْرُوت. بَيْرُوت مَدِينَة جَمِيلَة.
lines.en: I am Lebanese, from Beirut. Beirut is a beautiful city.

lines.ar: وَسَامِي مِنْ أَيْنَ؟ هُوَ مِنْ بَيْرُوت أَيْضًا؟
lines.en: And where is Sami from? Is he from Beirut too?

lines.ar: لَا، سَامِي مِصْرِيّ. هُوَ مِنَ الْقَاهِرَة.
lines.en: No, Sami is Egyptian. He is from Cairo.

lines.ar: نَعَم، أَنَا مِنَ الْقَاهِرَة. الْقَاهِرَة كَبِيرَة جِدًّا!
lines.en: Yes, I am from Cairo. Cairo is very big!

lines.ar: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْقَاهِرَة! الْمَدِينَة جَمِيلَة وَالنَّاس لُطَفَاء.
lines.en: I love Cairo! The city is beautiful and the people are kind.

lines.ar: شُكْرًا يَا دَانْيَال! وَالْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم مِصْرِيّ أَيْضًا.
lines.en: Thank you, Daniel! And Mr Karim is Egyptian too.

lines.ar: وَالطُّلَّاب فِي الصَّفّ مِنْ بِلَاد كَثِيرَة.
lines.en: And the students in the class are from many countries.

lines.ar: صَحِيح! مِنْ أَمْرِيكَا وَلُبْنَان وَمِصْر وَبِلَاد أُخْرَى.
lines.en: That's right! From America, Lebanon, Egypt and other countries.

lines.ar: هٰذَا جَمِيل! الصَّفّ مِثْل عَائِلَة كَبِيرَة.
lines.en: That is lovely! The class is like a big family.
Yes, a big and very beautiful family!

reading.title: Sami's notebook
reading.ar: اِسْمِي سَامِي. أَنَا مِصْرِيّ مِنَ الْقَاهِرَة. صَدِيقِي دَانْيَال أَمْرِيكِيّ.
reading.en: My name is Sami. I am Egyptian, from Cairo. My friend Daniel is American.

quiz.prompt: Layla is from Lebanon. She is …
In the dialogue, where is Sami from?
How do you say 'He is Egyptian'?
Which letter is said like th in 'this'?
What does the shadda mark do?

completion: Excellent! You can say where you are from and give nationalities. You now know eleven letters.
